latest_cos_commentary.headline: Retail Technology Group is a St. Louis-based POS deployment and field-services company, now part of Advantech-AURES following AURES Technologies' 2018 acquisition of RTG and Advantech's 2024 acquisition of AURES.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: RTG does not sell its own competing POS software; it deploys, stages, and services third-party POS hardware/software (potentially including Genius) for multi-location restaurant and retail brands, so it competes more with Genius's own deployment/field-services capabilities than with its software.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Ownership has changed twice in recent years (AURES in 2018, then Advantech's 2024 acquisition of AURES), which may affect strategic priorities or US investment levels.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Confirm during discovery whether RTG's involvement in an account is as a rollout/installation partner or tied to a specific hardware manufacturer alignment (Advantech-AURES kiosks) before treating it as a head-to-head POS competitor.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: RTG is primarily a services/logistics company, not a software platform; its tracked relationship to Genius likely centers on field-services/deployment competition rather than payments or POS software rivalry.
